name: Turn a folder of invoices into one spreadsheet
audience: Bookkeeping, expenses, anyone doing data entry from PDFs
summary: Read every invoice in a folder, pull out the numbers that matter, and write one CSV with a row per invoice. Invoices it cannot read are listed at the end rather than guessed at.
needs: A folder of invoices, granted in Providers under Folders

steps.instruction: List every file in the granted invoices folder and report the full path of each one, as a JSON array of strings and nothing else.

Read the invoice at the path you were given and pull out one record: supplier, invoice number, date, currency, net, tax, total, and the purchase order if it names one. Copy every value exactly as printed. A field the invoice does not state is null — never a plausible guess, and never a total you worked out yourself.

Write a CSV of every record above. Header row first: supplier,invoice_number,date,currency,net,tax,total,po. One row per invoice, values exactly as extracted, empty cell where a field was null. After the CSV, list any invoice that could not be read and say why.
